description: Background job: build or repair a saved plan. It first clears cells that must be empty and blocks that are wrong (wrong block, or the right one facing the wrong way), then places the blocks bottom-up with the exact properties of the plan (choosing where to stand and how to click), the hanging and standing ones (torches, doors, ladders, beds) last, then runs build_verify. method 'place' builds like a player from the inventory (fails up front when materials are missing); 'set' writes blocks on the server (needs enableWorldWrite) without items.

waitSeconds.description: Block up to this many seconds for the job to finish before returning (default 0: return at once).

name: build_structure
title: Build a plan (job)
